blocks.text: 1 Samuel 28 contains 25 verses. It opens with: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their hosts together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me in the host, thou and thy men. It concludes with: and she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
